# Concurrent-operations pass (FIDESLIB_CONCURRENT_OPS=1): tests whose result changes
# from run to run. The check skips them; every run also runs them as a report that
# never fails the check. One gtest filter pattern per line.

# A [staged] stage reported MISMATCH on the first attempt and passed on a retry,
# so a lane's result depends on timing.
